text: 工业和信息化部总经济师高东升日前在上海举行的2026工业文化发展大会上说，发展工业文化、推动文化赋能，是推进新型工业化、发展先进制造业的重要举措，未来将加大工业遗产资源保护利用力度，高质量构建工业遗产保护体系，建立国家工业遗产档案数据库，推动工业文化向新而行、向深迈进。高东升说，下一步将文化赋能贯穿于制造业各环节全链条，大力发展工业设计产业；深入探索文化、科技、产业融合发展有效机制，打造更多思政实践、科普教育、文旅消费新场景，实施工业文化数字工程，深化5G、北斗、虚拟现实、人工智能等新技术应用；实施新时代中国工业形象塑造和传播工程，支持鼓励工业题材影视、
text_en: Gao Dongsheng, chief economist of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, said recently at the 2026 Industrial Culture Development Conference held in Shanghai that developing industrial culture and promoting cultural empowerment are important measures for advancing new industrialization and developing advanced manufacturing. In the future, efforts will be stepped up to protect and utilize industrial heritage resources, build a high-quality industrial heritage protection system, establish a national industrial heritage archive database, and push industrial culture toward new frontiers and deeper development. Gao Dongsheng said that next, cultural empowerment will be integrated throughout every link and the entire chain of manufacturing, and the industrial design industry will be vigorously developed; effective mechanisms for the integrated development of culture, technology and industry will be further explored, more new scenarios for ideological and political practice, science popularization education and cultural tourism consumption will be created, a digital project for industrial culture will be implemented, and the application of new technologies such as 5G, BeiDou, virtual reality and artificial intelligence will be deepened; a project to shape and communicate China's industrial image in the new era will be implemented, and support and encouragement will be given to film and television works and other content on industrial themes,
